text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease.

The clinical presentation of a 7-year-old male with a limp and left knee pain (referred hip pain), combined with normal inflammatory markers, negative stress fracture indicators, and no systemic symptoms, strongly points to idiopathic avascular necrosis of the femoral head. The absence of morning stiffness or gel phenomenon further supports this mechanical/developmental diagnosis over juvenile idiopathic arthritis.
